name: stripe
description: Official Stripe @stripe/mcp. The key is supplied through the server process environment (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY), not written into args or this JSON; a remote form also exists at https://mcp.stripe.com (OAuth), see README.

metadata.install: No installation needed (npx fetches on demand)
metadata.env_hint: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (environment variable on the server process; it can also be passed as args --api-key=..., but then the key lands in the database)
